In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

DL Lite logics are the most expressive DLs for which the whole spectrum of DL reasoning tasks can be carried out efficiently, and which at the same time are the most suitable for representing large amounts of instance level information.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have identified the maximal DLs that are both expressive enough to capture ontology languages and tractable enough to support query answering over large amount of data.
the DL Lite logics are the most expressive DLs for which query answering over ABoxes is tractable, and at the same time the most expressive tractable DLs for which reasoning is tractable as well.
the logics in the DL Lite family provide a good compromise between expressivity, computational complexity, and practicality of query processing.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the complexity of DLs is not only a matter of the complexity of reasoning over the TBox, but also of the complexity of query answering over the ABox.
, in the context of ontology languages, tractability is not only a matter of reasoning, but also of efficient query processing.
ontology languages can be tailored to the needs of applications, and that the resulting ontology languages may have very different expressive power and complexity.
